confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or price pages were checked. Turkish lira inflation and volatility make USD levels less certain, so accommodation, cocktail and wine anchors are lower confidence than restaurant and beer anchors. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page; the F11.1 table row was not directly read, and the 16 October figure was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Turkish tourist-city price levels in USD terms, with a cross-check against Eastern Mediterranean and Balkan capitals of similar tourism demand. July is treated as peak season for accommodation.
